# Tidepool Landing Page Build Plan

**Global system:** Cream base (#FAF7F2), deep-teal text (#0E4A4A), seafoam accents (#9AD1C9), coral CTAs (#FF6B57). Fraunces (display serif) for headlines, Inter for body. Rounded 16px corners, generous whitespace, soft shadows. Calm ocean vibe without kitsch.

**1. Sticky nav** — Cream bar, wave-glyph wordmark left; Product / Pricing / FAQ links right; coral "Start free" pill button. Labels only, no copy.

**2. Hero** — Centered, 60vh, subtle animated seafoam gradient wave in background. Headline (Fraunces, 56px): "Plan the week without the meeting." Subhead: "Tidepool gives small teams one calm place to share what everyone's working on — by Friday, the next week is already clear." CTAs: "Start free — no card" + "Watch 90-sec demo." Below, a floating product screenshot.

**3. Social proof** — One muted line: "Trusted by 2,000+ small teams" with five monochrome logos.

**4. Problem** — Two columns. Left: large pull-quote, "Mondays shouldn't disappear into status meetings." Right: three pain bullets (scattered updates, surprise workloads, meeting fatigue) in muted teal.

**5. How it works** — Three columns, numbered chips in seafoam: "Post your week in 2 minutes," "Shape it together async," "Sync Monday in one glance." Small line illustrations per step.

**6. Product tour** — Full-width annotated screenshot of the weekly board. Four floating callout cards: shared priorities, workload balance, async check-ins, Friday auto-recap. Alternating white/cream band.

**7. Testimonial** — Deep-teal full-bleed band, one oversized cream quote: "We killed our Monday meeting. Nobody misses it." — attribution with team size ("Maya, 7-person studio").

**8. Final CTA** — Centered on cream: "Find your team's rhythm." Coral button: "Start your 14-day free trial." Below, thin FAQ accordion (4 questions: security, integrations, pricing, migration).

**9. Footer** — Sand background (#EFE7DA), four link columns, tiny wave divider top, copyright line.
final:
# Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

*Key upgrades: sharper narrative arc (problem → proof → objection handling → price), sticky-scroll tour, metric-driven social proof, added pricing teaser.*

**Global system:** Cream (#FAF7F2), deep-teal text (#0E4A4A), seafoam (#9AD1C9), coral CTAs (#FF6B57). Fraunces display type (56/40/28px), Inter body (18/16). Hand-drawn 2px teal line illustrations throughout — no stock photography. Voice: plain-spoken and time-obsessed ("minutes," "Mondays," "Fridays"), zero corporate hype.

**1. Nav** — Sticky cream bar; wave-glyph wordmark; Product / Pricing / FAQ; coral "Start free week" pill (echoes hero language).

**2. Hero** — 60vh, slow 8s seafoam wave animation. Headline: "The Monday meeting, gone. The clarity, kept." Subhead: "Everyone posts their week in under two minutes. By Monday 9am, priorities, workload, and blockers sit on one shared board." Coral "Start free" + ghost "Watch 90-sec demo." Visual: tilted board screenshot with an overlapping "Friday Recap" card — show the output, not just the tool.

**3. Proof strip** — Logos plus an on-message metric: "41,000 Monday meetings skipped since 2023."

**4. Problem** — Left: oversized stat, "A weekly status meeting costs a 7-person team 30 hours — every week." Right: three specific pains — updates scattered across Slack and memory; a teammate underwater, unnoticed until Friday; a meeting where everyone just says "fine."

**5. How it works** — Week-rhythm framing with timestamp chips: "Monday, 9:00 — 2-minute check-in," "Midweek — shape it async," "Friday — auto-recap sets up next week."

**6. Product tour** — Sticky-scroll: left text steps through four features while the right screenshot highlights matching zones (priorities, workload, check-ins, recap).

**7. Objection band** — Slim integration strip (Slack, Google Calendar, Asana, Linear): "Tidepool reads your stack. It doesn't replace it. Setup: five minutes."

**8. Testimonial** — Deep-teal full-bleed. Hero quote with a number: "We killed our Monday meeting. Nobody misses it." — Maya, 7-person studio, real photo avatar. Two smaller quotes flanking: agency, nonprofit.

**9. Pricing teaser** — Three cards: Free (up to 5), Team $6/person/mo (coral highlight), Scale. One line each, no feature dump.

**10. Final CTA + FAQ** — "Find your team's rhythm," coral trial button. Four real objections: "Do we quit our Monday meeting?," security, "What if people stop posting?," migration.

**11. Footer** — Sand (#EFE7DA), wave divider, four link columns, "Made for calm Mondays."
